parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the instance IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region.

parameters.name: IdleTime
parameters.description: The wait period for the instance that has no traffic to become idle. Minimum value: 60. Default value: 600. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs. For more information about how to obtain the ID of a resource group, see [View basic information of a resource group](~~151181~~).

parameters.name: ServerlessResource
parameters.description: The threshold of computing resources. Valid values: 8 to 32. Unit: AnalyticDB Compute Units (ACUs).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb modify-db-instance-config --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --db-instance-id gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --db-instance-description gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --serverless-resource 32 --idle-time 600 --region cn-hangzhou
